dedupe_keys.name: kerbtrack syn 5 114 synthetic images of kerbside household bulk waste for detection models

description: KerbTrack-Syn is a set of 5,114 high-resolution synthetic images of household bulk waste left on the kerb, such as discarded furniture and appliances. It was deposited on figshare in September 2026 by Umair Iqbal, Marcella Papini, Johan Barthelemy of the University of Wollongong, Pascal Perez of the University of Melbourne and Misbah Zulfiqar. The images were generated with a FLUX-LoRA image generation workflow guided by real images from the KerbTrack benchmark dataset, and are meant for research on object detection, monitoring of illegal dumping, smart waste management and AI-based urban sensing. The archive, about 9 GB, is free to download under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence. Caveats: the images are generated, not photographed, so models trained on them must be checked on real scenes, and the metadata do not describe annotations or file layout. Simulation uses: training data for camera-based detection of dumped bulk waste, feeding inspection and collection planning models. Related records: the Bangladesh illegal dumping image dataset (data-bangladesh-illegal-dumping-images-urban) gives real photographs, and the UAV dumped waste detection model (model-dumped-waste-uav-detection) addresses a similar task from the air.
